summary: Session 95 fresh post-recovery audit merged six premise-verified findings into the exhausted Session 94 ledger. Required skill commands are missing from the project root; closeout does not format its new doctor sidecar before staging; full-tree secret review is drowned by 1,974 low-confidence asset matches; an unused Studio Ops Obelisk broker is publicly tracked; identity introspection has no deadline; and Vite assigns resources to both public and module ownership, producing a warning flood. Coverage is 218/218 files and 1,165/1,165 tests with 35.49% lines; broad coverage work was rejected in favor of the exact unbounded identity seam. External launch observations remain NO-GO.

infrastructure.result: Fresh audit verified six bounded seams: missing protocol bridges, non-idempotent generated-sidecar formatting, asset secret-scan noise, a public orphaned control-plane broker, unbounded identity introspection, and dual-owned static assets.

gameLoop.result: Core certified loop and new personal-agency/Doctrine surfaces remain strong. No balance or retention premise was admitted without human evidence; this pass protects admission reliability and developer feedback instead.

Core-loop step: player/operator input → trusted public surface → safe participation reward → identity progression.

items.title: Preserve secret blocking while eliminating asset entropy noise
items.why: The canonical full-tree scan emits 1,974 findings, all low-confidence matches inside existing base64 SVG, flag, cosmetic, and copied static assets, with zero medium/high findings. A signal this noisy is unusable for sanitization review and can hide the one real credential that matters.
items.recipe: Classify entropy-only patterns separately from semantic credential patterns; suppress low-confidence random-token matches only inside verified asset payload contexts and generated resource mirrors; keep every medium/high pattern blocking everywhere; deduplicate copied static/resource evidence; expose confidence counts; and add fixtures proving real keys in source or SVG text still fail. Core-loop step: security input → trusted build/release fantasy → clean evidence reward → safe progression.

L1.recipe: Skip low-confidence entropy matches inside base64 image payloads only.

L2.recipe: Deduplicate generated resource mirrors and report confidence counts.

L3.recipe: Context classifier, adversarial real-key fixtures, exact zero-noise full-tree receipt, and staged-scan parity.

items.coreLoopStep: security input → trusted build/release fantasy → clean evidence reward → safe progression

items.title: Bound remote identity introspection during game admission

items.recipe: Add an explicit short admission deadline with AbortController ownership and exact timer cleanup; inject fetch for deterministic tests; normalize client-visible failure while retaining safe operator diagnostics; prove success, non-200, invalid schema, network error, and never-resolving provider behavior; keep existing EdDSA issuer/audience verification unchanged. Core-loop step: player login input → bounded match admission → playable fantasy reward → account progression.

L2.recipe: Inject fetch and cover all response/error branches.

L3.recipe: Leak-safe normalized receipt, timer-cleanup proof, admission-latency contract, and Worker integration assertion.

items.title: Make doctor sidecar closeout byte-idempotent
items.why: project-doctor writes audits/doctor-latest.json with JSON.stringify formatting, while closeout-autopilot formats only STARTUP_BRIEF and PROJECT_STATUS before staging. The pre-commit hook then rewrites the sidecar, so every closeout starts with avoidable byte churn and the closeout runner violates the Session 92 decision that it formats every generated truth surface itself.
items.recipe: Include the doctor sidecar in the closeout generated-format step, verify its canonical content digest remains stable across whitespace changes, and add a regression that runs the formatter path twice and observes no second diff. Preserve the content-canonical evidence hash contract rather than hashing file bytes. Core-loop step: operator verification input → trustworthy evidence → confident shipment → reliable progression.

L3.recipe: Two-pass byte-idempotency regression plus generated-surface ownership contract.

The server validates shape and IP rate only; it does not verify actor membership, live game ownership, or that the event occurred. GameServer imports NarratorBus only to close it, so AI commentary can be driven by browser-authored fiction.
